name: Machine Donkey Calf Raise
steps: Place the balls of your feet on the footplate and hinge forward until the pad rests across your hips.
Rest your forearms on the front support and keep your knees slightly bent and your back neutral.
Lower your heels until you feel a comfortable stretch in your calves.
Drive forcefully through the balls of your feet to lift your heels as high as possible, squeezing your calves briefly at the top.
tips: Keep your knee angle steady so the heels rise and fall through ankle movement.
Pause briefly at the bottom stretch to prevent bouncing the load.
